lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Approximately four semi-horizontal rows of high-luminance circular spots are visible posterior to the gill slits, with a higher concentration of smaller spots located closer to the pectoral fin base.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Multiple longitudinal ridges are visible running horizontally along the upper flank, characterized by high-luminance dorsal edges and shadowed ventral gradients.

other_distinctive_markers: The dorsal surface of the visible pectoral fin contains a dense distribution of small, high-luminance blobs of varying diameters.
